title: Transfer and Choice Program Request Calendar and Placement Terms
content:
The district publishes, for each enrollment type of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the annual window in which transfer and choice-program requests are taken, the date by which decisions on requests filed in the window are issued, the time a family has to accept an approved placement, and how long a placement lasts.

## Request window and decision calendar

Window dates are written day and month (MM-DD). The window opens in the calendar year the requested school year starts, except that choice-program windows open in the preceding calendar year. The last day of the window is included.

| Enrollment type | Window opens | Window closes (inclusive) | Decisions on window requests issued by | Calendar days to accept an approved placement (decision date is day 0) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 (not applicable) |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | 01-11 (11 January) | 02-26 (26 February) | 04-16 (16 April) | 10 |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | 01-11 (11 January) | 06-30 (30 June) | 04-16 (16 April) | 10 |
| Non-Resident Transfer | 01-11 (11 January) | 02-26 (26 February) | 04-16 (16 April) | 10 |
| Choice Program Enrollment | 11-02 (2 November of the preceding calendar year) | 01-15 (15 January) | 03-05 (5 March) | 10 |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 (not applicable) |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | not applicable | not applicable | not applicable | 0 (not applicable) |

## Requests outside the window and length of a placement

| Enrollment type | A request filed outside the window is considered for the current school year | When a mid-year approved placement takes effect | How long an approved placement lasts | Placement must be requested again for every school year | Sibling priority (a student whose sibling attends the requested campus on a placement of the same type is decided ahead of other requests) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | yes | not applicable | not applicable | no | no |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | no | not applicable | through the campus's highest grade | no | yes |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | yes | upon acceptance | a single school year | yes | no |
| Non-Resident Transfer | no | not applicable | a single school year | yes | no |
| Choice Program Enrollment | no | not applicable | through the campus's highest grade | no | yes |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | yes | not applicable | not applicable | no | no |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | yes | not applicable | not applicable | no | no |

## Reading the calendar: worked dates (hypothetical)

- Acceptance period of 10 calendar days, decision issued on a hypothetical 3 March: 3 March is day 0, so day 10 is 13 March. An acceptance on 13 March still counts; an acceptance on 14 March is too late.
- Space-available window: a request received on 26 February is inside the window, because the closing day is included; a request received on 27 February is outside it, and space-available requests filed outside the window are not considered for the current school year.
- Employee-child window: a request received on 15 August is outside the window, but employee-child requests filed outside the window are still considered for the current school year, and such a mid-year placement takes effect upon acceptance.
